payload.text: ST0086 WP-04 Part B, the page face of AC-04.6, on vc's orders, now in Intent's ONE judge run (vc decision 100, which records hv's "Ok, push on." and hv's selection "One run, nine banks"). When molt-vc closes L1 (Intent is L2 in hv's layer order, molt-vc decision 22), Part B's re-ask carries nine banks through judge-rerun.sh in this order: cc's refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-status-v2 (patch-id 4ae2585f7479) and wp04b-wait-v2 (2421b3d9719d), ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04b-page-v2 (blob a10e09b24211, patch-id 8126a568631b), cc's wp04b-init-v1 (e8aee9ac86d6) and wp04b-ats-v1 (f649be3fa3ea), ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/pipeline-cell-width-v4 (blob f2dc986d8c7c, patch-id e058514c0734), then cc's 0657 v2 and ST0081 WP-02 v1, then ic's 0658 v3 (doing 137). All nine apply in that order on main 21d764a94 to tree 4944cfe4135a, measured in temp indexes by vc, cc and ic. Page v2: each lane lists its queued asks under its holders (`lanes[].queue`), and a controller.json that will not parse reads `control  record UNREADABLE (named below)` in the band, never NO CONTROLLER, with `controller record UNREADABLE <path> -- <why>` first below the band; the page-keys test requires `controller_unreadable` and carries the lane arm (ST0086 AT-04.6). Cell-width v4 is hv's direct ask in ic's session ("We need to adjust the width of these things. That's bonkers."): `.cell` is `flex: 0 0 18rem; min-width: 0`, `.what` clamps at four lines and `.meta` at two, CSS only in shell.html; v1 to v3 are superseded. Neither bank carries a CHANGELOG hunk: ic sent vc both lines as text on 2026-10-27, the cell-width one describing the pipeline strip as it ships, since the strip (AC-04.7, ea94f91b0) landed with no line. The run's render leg runs ic's render tools v3 (refs/bank/ic/tools/render-states.sh 96c9f5840582, prelude.js 942b1e87c794). A red in either ic bank comes back to ic in tmp/wt-ic-0086b, kept until the landing; if a bank under ic's moves, ic re-banks over the new tree. After a green run there is one landing chain, one build all, one kovacs preflight and one push (decision 100), and then ic looks at the cards on the live page. No claim: the work package is cc's. No push, no release.
